register.reg_condition: when FEAT_ITE is implemented, System register access to the trace unit registers is implemented, and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Provides EL2 controls for Trace Instrumentation.

configuration_text.para: If EL2 is not implemented, this register is RES0 from EL3.

field_value_description.para: Instrumentation trace not prohibited at EL2.

field_description.para: This field is ignored by the PE when any of the following are true:

listitem.content: The Effective value of HCR_EL2.TGE is 0.
EL2 is disabled in the current Security state.

field_value_description.para: Instrumentation trace prohibited at EL0 when the Effective value of HCR_EL2.TGE is 1.
Instrumentation trace not prohibited at EL0 when the Effective value of HCR_EL2.TGE is 1.

access_permission_text.para: When the Effective value of HCR_EL2.E2H is 1, without explicit synchronization, accesses from EL2 using the accessor name TRCITECR_EL2 or TRCITECR_EL1 are not guaranteed to be ordered with respect to accesses using the other accessor name.
